description: This file contains Redux-Observable epics for managing challenge code storage, including saving, loading, and clearing challenge code in local storage, with legacy support and challenge-specific logic.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves code from store by id, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getLegacyCode
methods.description: Retrieves legacy code from store, handling legacy prefixes and postfix.

methods.name: legacyToFile
methods.description: Converts legacy code into file format if all files are poly.

methods.name: isFilesAllPoly
methods.description: Checks if all challenge files are poly files.

methods.name: clearCodeEpic
methods.description: Epic to clear stored code on challenge reset or submit complete.

methods.name: saveCodeEpic
methods.description: Epic to save challenge files to local storage and show success/error message.

methods.name: loadCodeEpic
methods.description: Epic to load challenge code from local storage or legacy formats.
